save_unsloth_model: save a trained unsloth model with merged LoRA weights to float16 or 4bit format locally or push to HuggingFace Hub
convert_to_gguf: convert a finetuned HuggingFace model to GGUF format with optional quantization for llama.cpp compatibility
push_to_huggingface_repo: create a HuggingFace Hub repository with auto-generated model card and upload a finetuned model
patch_saving_functions: patch a model instance with unsloth-specific save and push methods for LoRA, GGUF, and TorchAO workflows
save_lora_to_ggml: convert saved LoRA adapters to GGML format using llama.cpp for use as inference adapters
